crossing_derivation.note: This timing is why the predicted crossing is B=20. It is not the definition of crossing. The median finished close plus the A0 median greedy TTA fits inside 10 s. The p90 of that sum is above 10 s and at or below 20 s. The 329 censored steps did not close inside the as-implemented 10 s budget, so this timing does not say they close by 20 s.

estimate_derivation.a0_ceiling: The sealed [:100] wall_s plus (B - 10) for each of the 5 steps with tta_s at 10, plus load_s and canary_overhead_s, then the next whole second.
estimate_derivation.a4_ceiling: For a contiguous slice, estimate_s is the next whole second of (A0 step count on the slice) * B + load_s + canary_overhead_s. A step cannot outlast the per-step budget.
estimate_derivation.a0_second_ceiling: The sealed lexicographic [100:200] wall_s plus (B - 10) for each of the 9 steps with tta_s equal to 10, plus the same load_s and canary_overhead_s, then the next whole second.
estimate_derivation.slice_rule: An A4 cell is the longest contiguous prefix of the remaining entries whose A0 step count times B, plus load_s and canary_overhead_s, is at most 7200 s, recorded as the next whole second. The same rule reproduces the lexicographic [:100] slices.

sweep.comparison: Paired against the sweep A0 at the same budget, seed, and entries. b is A0 pass and A4 fail. c is A0 fail and A4 pass. p is the two-sided exact binomial test on the discordant pairs.
sweep.entries: lexicographic [:100], then lexicographic [100:200] after every [:100] budget
sweep.floor: At each budget the fixed A4 in-budget count is at least the paired sweep A0 count on the same entries. At B=10 on lexicographic [:100] that floor is also at least the sealed A0 count of 14. The same construction applies to lexicographic [100:200]; the sealed A0 in-budget count there is 9 and is a record of 8a529053, not a second predicted count. A think which does not emit </think> and a parseable tool call inside the remaining time keeps the greedy answer. A think that does close and parse can replace that answer, including a correct one. That residual is recorded. The floor holds by construction against the A4-as-implemented failure, which had no greedy answer to keep.

close_fraction.derivation: Run 3b4d8207 gave thinking the whole step and cut it at 10 s. Of 489 steps, 160 have thinking_stripped and retained_tokens greater than 0: the think block closed and a nonempty remainder was kept. Close time is emitted_tokens minus retained_tokens, divided by that step's rate_tok_s. Every one of those 160 close times is at or below 9.908873608555902 s. The other 329 steps have retained_tokens 0. They are right-censored at 10 s and are not counted as closes. Generation text is not stored, so those 160 are not known to be parseable tool calls. A parseable close is a subset of a nonempty close. The floor counts only the observed nonempty closes, 160/489. That rate is the censored-data lower bound at B=10, B=20, and B=30, because every observed close is already inside 10 s and a censored step is never counted. The fixed arm gives thinking only the time left after the greedy stream, which is shorter than the 10 s exposure that produced this bound.
close_fraction.quantity: Fraction of fixed-A4 steps whose thinking decode emits </think> and whose answer after it parses as a tool call, with that decode finishing inside B. Reported at B=10, B=20, and B=30.

procedure: Stream the greedy answer first with thinking off, the same anytime cutoff as A0. Remaining time R = B - elapsed. If R > 0, one sampled thinking decode with temperature 0.6, top_p 0.95, top_k 20, and max_new_tokens = floor(R * measured decode tok/s / 1). The rate is the greedy decode just measured, or the P0-v2 table rate when that measurement is missing. The streamer still stops at R. Use the thinking answer only when the produced text contains </think> and the answer after it parses as a tool call. Otherwise keep the greedy text and do not execute the thinking text. Record the greedy call hash, whether the think closed, whether the answer parsed, and whether it was accepted. If the thinking generate raises, the exception text is stored on the step as thinking_error and the greedy answer is kept.

thinking_length.definition: Generation text is not stored. On a step with thinking_stripped and retained_tokens > 0, tokens to </think> are emitted_tokens minus retained_tokens. Steps with retained_tokens 0 left no answer after the strip and are excluded.
thinking_length.seconds_note: Each finished step divides its token length by that step rate_tok_s.

why: Run 3b4d8207 decoded thinking as the only sample and labeled that sample greedy. multi_turn_base_12 steps 0 and 1 emitted 215 and 257 tokens, TTA 10 s, retained_tokens 0, greedy_call_sha256 null. There was no greedy answer to keep. The fixed arm streams the A0 greedy answer first, then samples a thinking decode inside the remaining time, and uses that decode only when it emitted </think> and a parseable tool call. 3b4d8207 stays A4-as-implemented and is not the registered comparison. The budget sweep is the registered measurement of the fixed arm, and it runs after A5.

crossing.definition: The smallest B in {10, 20, 30} at which fixed A4 in-budget passes exceed the paired sweep A0 and the McNemar p is below 0.05. Pairs share the seed, the entries, and the budget. b is A0 pass and A4 fail. c is A0 fail and A4 pass. p is the two-sided exact binomial test on the discordant pairs.
crossing.falsified_if: B=10 crosses, or no B in {10, 20, 30} crosses. Report which of those two occurred.
